name: Megido 72
source: "Megido 72" is a smartphone game app developed by Media Vision and operated by DeNA. The service began on December 7, 2017. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases. This RPG, an original IP by DeNA for smart devices, is set in three worlds: "Harmalia," inhabited by angels (Haruma); "Vaigard," inhabited by humans (Vita); and "Megidral," inhabited by demons (Megido). The story follows young heroes striving to prevent the world's end, "Harmageddon."
translation: 《Megido 72》是一款由Media Vision开发、DeNA运营的智能手机游戏应用程序。该服务于2017年12月7日开始。这是一款带有应用内购买功能的免费游戏。这款RPG是DeNA为智能设备打造的原创IP，以三个世界为背景：天使（Haruma）居住的“Harmalia”；“Vaigard”，居住着人类（Vita）；以及恶魔居住的“Megidral”（Megido）。故事讲述了年轻的英雄们努力阻止世界末日“哈米吉多顿”的故事。
